concept: A property brokerage; search, valuation tool and agent request.

shots.title: Hero
shots.section: Home hero, full screen behind the headline
shots.camera: Eye-level three-quarter view, 24mm tilt-shift, corrected verticals
shots.prompt: Architectural photograph of a contemporary family villa in Dubai. Golden-hour sun rakes across the facade, verticals perfectly straight, landscaped foreground, clear sky with open space above for a headline. It must feel built and lived-in, not rendered. No people. Overall look: bright real-estate brand photography, 35mm; colour palette of navy, white, brass, sand. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.

shots.title: Hero for phones
shots.prompt: Vertical architectural photograph looking up along a contemporary family villa in Dubai, facade lines converging into a clear sky, sunlight catching the main materials, strong graphic composition. No people. Overall look: bright real-estate brand photography, 35mm; colour palette of navy, white, brass, sand. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.

shots.title: Aerial
shots.prompt: Drone photograph of a contemporary family villa in Dubai, seen from about 120 metres at a 45-degree angle: the building, plot, access, landscaping and any nearby water clearly readable. Soft morning light, true colours, light haze on the horizon. No people visible. Overall look: bright real-estate brand photography, 35mm; colour palette of navy, white, brass, sand. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.

shots.title: Blue hour
shots.prompt: Blue-hour photograph of a contemporary family villa in Dubai: interiors glowing warm behind the glass, exterior lighting on, deep blue sky with a last band of light on the horizon, reflections on water or wet paving. No people. Overall look: bright real-estate brand photography, 35mm; colour palette of navy, white, brass, sand. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.

shots.title: Interiors
shots.camera: Interior, 24mm, eye level, one window light
shots.prompt: A 2x2 grid of four separate photographs separated by thin white gutters, all four in one consistent style and light. Interior photographs inside a contemporary family villa, finished in staged homes, staged and uncluttered, one soft daylight, nobody present. Top-left: the main living room with its view. Top-right: the kitchen and dining area. Bottom-left: the principal bedroom. Bottom-right: the principal bathroom. Overall look: bright real-estate brand photography, 35mm; colour palette of navy, white, brass, sand. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.

shots.title: Amenities

shots.title: Lifestyle
shots.prompt: Editorial lifestyle photograph at a contemporary family villa in Dubai: a broker, face turned away, handing keys to a couple. Candid, natural light, believable and calm. Every person in the picture is a clearly different individual (age, build, skin tone, hair and clothing all vary) so no face is repeated; faces may be turned away or out of frame. Overall look: bright real-estate brand photography, 35mm; colour palette of navy, white, brass, sand. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermarks.
